ns2:course.label: Individual Field Research
ns2:course.description: Supervised participation in field research in ethnography, ethnology, linguistics, or social anthropology; techniques, methods, and procedures discussed and practiced under actual working conditions. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated if topics vary. Usually offered in the summer session only. Prerequisite: ANTH 230 or ANTH 400; some knowledge of the language of the area concerned; consent of instructor. Normally taken concurrently with ANTH 497.
